Build a professional, production-ready Android Music Streaming Application named "INDIAN MUSIC".

MAIN CONCEPT:
Create an online music streaming platform where the Admin can upload songs, and all users who install the Android application can discover and listen to those songs online.

IMPORTANT:
This must be a fully functional online music application, not just a UI design or demo application.

1. USER APPLICATION

Create a modern and attractive music streaming interface.

Features:

- Home Screen
- All Songs
- Latest Songs
- Trending Songs
- Recently Added
- Search Songs
- Music Categories
- Artists
- Playlists
- Favorites
- Recently Played

2. MUSIC PLAYER

Create a professional music player with:

- Play / Pause
- Next Song
- Previous Song
- Seek Bar
- Song Duration
- Volume Control
- Background Music Playback
- Lock Screen Controls
- Notification Music Controls
- Shuffle Mode
- Repeat Mode
- Album Artwork
- Song Title and Artist Name

Users should be able to listen to songs online without downloading them.

3. ADMIN PANEL

Create a secure Admin Dashboard accessible only to the authorized administrator.

Admin Features:

- Upload MP3 Audio Files
- Upload Song Cover Images
- Add Song Title
- Add Singer Name
- Add Album Name
- Add Music Category
- Add Song Description
- Publish Songs Online
- Edit Song Details
- Delete Songs
- Manage Playlists
- View Total Songs
- View Total Users
- View Song Plays

When Admin uploads a new song, it should automatically become available in the application for all users.

4. ONLINE DATABASE & STORAGE

Use a reliable cloud backend.

Requirements:

- Secure cloud database
- Cloud audio storage
- Song metadata management
- Audio streaming URLs
- Automatic synchronization
- Secure admin authentication
- User authentication (optional)

All uploaded songs must remain available online until the Admin removes them.

5. DESIGN

Create a premium music application UI.

Design Style:

- Modern dark theme
- Black background
- Purple and blue gradient accents
- Premium music player
- Smooth animations
- Attractive song cards
- Beautiful album artwork
- Responsive Android interface

6. APK DEVELOPMENT

Build a complete Android application.

Requirements:

- Generate installable APK
- Application Name: INDIAN MUSIC
- Package Name: com.indianmusic.app
- Android compatibility
- Internet connectivity
- Background audio playback
- Proper permissions
- Fast loading
- Error handling

7. IMPORTANT FUNCTIONAL REQUIREMENTS

- Admin uploads songs only once.
- Uploaded songs automatically appear for every user.
- Users can search and play songs.
- New songs should appear without requiring an APK update.
- Audio must stream from cloud storage.
- Music should continue playing when the screen is locked.
- Support multiple simultaneous listeners.
- Display loading indicators while songs load.
- Handle slow internet connections properly.

8. SECURITY

- Only authorized Admin can upload, edit, or delete songs.
- Normal users must not access Admin functions.
- Protect cloud storage and database.
- Validate uploaded audio files.
- Upload only music for which the administrator has permission or distribution rights.

FINAL DELIVERABLE:

Provide:

1. Complete Android application source code.
2. Fully working Admin Panel.
3. Connected Cloud Database.
4. Cloud Audio Storage.
5. Functional Music Streaming System.
6. Installable Android APK.
7. Setup and deployment instructions.

Build this as a real online music streaming platform, not a static demo.
